description: Browse Compass.com homes for sale or for rent by city/neighborhood/ZIP, or fetch full details for specific listing URLs.

amenities.description: Only show listings with ALL selected amenities/features. Supported for both for-sale and for-rent.
amenities.title: Must-have amenities

comingSoonOnly.description: Only show listings marked "Coming Soon" (not yet officially on market).
comingSoonOnly.title: Coming soon only

listingCategory.description: Browse homes for sale, or homes for rent.
listingCategory.title: For sale or for rent

listingType.description: Restrict results to how the listing is being sold: through the MLS, as a Compass Platform Exclusive (not on the MLS), or For Sale By Owner.
listingType.title: Listing type

location.description: City, neighborhood, or ZIP to browse. Accepts a plain name like `Austin, TX` / `Miami Beach, FL`, or a Compass URL slug like `austin-tx` / `austin-tx-78734`. A ZIP code alone (e.g. `78734`) is not enough - append it to a city slug (`austin-tx-78734`) or just use `City, ST`.
location.title: Location (mode=search)

maxPrice.description: Drop listings priced above this amount (sale price or monthly rent).
maxPrice.title: Maximum price ($)

maxSqft.description: Drop listings larger than this many square feet.
maxSqft.title: Maximum square feet

minBaths.description: Drop listings with fewer bathrooms than this (e.g. 1.5).
minBaths.title: Minimum bathrooms

minBeds.description: Only show listings with at least this many bedrooms.
minBeds.title: Minimum bedrooms

minPrice.description: Drop listings priced below this amount (sale price or monthly rent).
minPrice.title: Minimum price ($)

minSqft.description: Drop listings smaller than this many square feet.
minSqft.title: Minimum square feet

mode.description: Browse listings for a location, fetch full details for specific listing URLs, or fetch agent profiles (bio + active/sold listings).
enumTitles: Get full details for listing URLs
Get agent profiles (bio, active & sold listings)
mode.title: Mode

newConstructionOnly.description: Only show newly built/new-construction listings. Supported for both for-sale and for-rent.
newConstructionOnly.title: New construction only

newListingOnly.description: Only show listings freshly marked "New" by Compass. Supported for both for-sale and for-rent.
newListingOnly.title: New listings only

noFeeOnly.description: Only show rentals with no broker/landlord fee ("No Fee" badge — common in NYC rental markets). Only supported when "For sale or for rent" is set to For rent.
noFeeOnly.title: No fee only

openHouseOnly.description: Only show listings with a scheduled open house.
openHouseOnly.title: Open houses only

pendingOnly.description: Only show listings that are under contract or pending (not yet sold/closed). Supported for both for-sale and for-rent. Mutually exclusive with "Sold only".
pendingOnly.title: Pending / under contract only

petFriendlyOnly.description: Only show rentals that allow pets. Only supported when "For sale or for rent" is set to For rent — Compass doesn't expose a pet-friendly filter for home sales.
petFriendlyOnly.title: Pet friendly only

propertyType.description: Restrict results to a property type.
propertyType.title: Property type

soldOnly.description: Only show recently sold/closed listings (comps). Only supported when "For sale or for rent" is set to For sale — Compass doesn't expose a reliable sold filter for rentals.
soldOnly.title: Sold only

virtualTourOnly.description: Only show listings that have a virtual tour. Supported for both for-sale and for-rent.
virtualTourOnly.title: Virtual tour only

title: Compass Real Estate Scraper Input
